meta.title: Umbrella Theme
meta.description: Umbrella Corporation palette over every surface and control, following the app or system appearance instead of pinning dark. Dark is the black-and-red page with Matrix-green terminal text; light is the same theme in white and grey, with near-black prose, deep-green code highlighting and the Umbrella red kept for buttons, tabs and marks. Includes the red-and-white umbrella mark in the sidebar and the new-session hero, a biohazard emblem beside the sidebar's user row, and an umbrella watermark that slowly spins about its own vertical centre line like a coin.
